verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an enterprise customer-support AI platform like Decagon, but the evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion workflows, or data-purge capability. The closest items are adjacent: short-lived JWT tokens discarded after each session is credential handling, not data retention; a vague mention of "data portability and control" for customer context does not describe retention or deletion; and Watchtower only flags privacy-policy violations in conversations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
